Ekstremitas superior

superioris:

phalanges: telapak tangan

n Bentuk “S”:

circumferentia articularis

Ekstremitas inferior
Terdiri dari:
n Cingulum pelvicum: Os    
coxae 
n Pars libera:
q Femur: tungkai atas
q patella
q Tibia; fibula: tungkai bawah
q Tarsalia, metatarsalia, 
phalanges: telapak kaki
Coxae
Terdiri dari 3 tulang yang mengalami fusi:
ilium, ischium, pubicum
n Ilium
q Corpus
membentuk 2/5 superior acetabulum
q Ala: crista iliaca, tuberculum iliacum, 
spina iliaca anterior superior, spine 
iliaca anterior inferior, spina iliaca 
posterior superior, spine iliaca 
posterior inferior, incisura ischiadica 
major, facies glutealis, fossa iliaca, 
linea arcuata, facies auricularis, 
tuberositas iliaca. 
n Ischium
q Corpus ― membentuk 2/5 posterior-
inferior acetabulum, spine ischiadica, 
incisura ischiadica minor
q Ramus, tuber ischiadicum
n Pubicum ― membentuk 1/5 anterior-
inferior acetabulum, eminentia 
iliopubica
q Ramus superior: pecten os pubis, 
pubic tuberculum pubicum, crista 
pubicum,  facies symphysialis
q Ramus inferior: foramen 
obturatorius
Acetabulum ― dibentuk oleh corpus os 
ischium, pubicum, ilium: facies lunata, 
fossa acetabuli, incisura acetabuli

condylus medialis dan

n Epiphysis distal: malleolus lateralis

Clinical aspect
nRadial head dislocation
nColle’s fx
nScaphoid fx
nBoxer fx
nBennet’s fx
Elbow: Radial head dislocation 
Wrist: Colles’ Fracture
Description
n When someone falls on their outstretched hand, they 
sometimes get a "broken wrist." The bone that is usually 
broken is distal end of radius. 
q Therefore, the medical term for the most common type of 
"broken wrist" is a distal radius fracture
n In fact, the radius is the most commonly broken bone in the 
arm. The break usually happens when you fall and land on 
your outstretched hands.
q Sometimes, the other forearm bone (the ulna) is also broken. 
When this happens, it is called a distal ulna fracture. 
n This fracture was first described by an Irish surgeon and 
anatomist, Abraham Colles, in 1814
Wrist: Scaphoid Fracture
• fall hyperextended wrist 
Wrist: Boxer’s Fx X-ray
distal 5th metacarpal, reduce if 
angulation > 30 
Bennett’s Fracture
n Description:
An intraarticular fracture of 
the base of the first 
metacarpal with 
involvement of 
carpometacarpal joint. 
Symptom is extreme pain at 
the base of thumb, with 
tenderness and swelling.
